Hi Pat,

The scientific background for your project including scientific merit of the proposed work:
Coastal flooding forecasts depend on ensemble ocean simulations that are too expensive to run at high resolution.
We propose learned surrogate models that emulate the ensemble at a fraction of the cost.

The surrogates will be validated against observed storm surges: they must match tide-gauge records.

Programming language: python, C++
Parallelization mechanism: none
Required software libraries: Pytorch, jax, numpy and mpi4py.

Number of CPU-cores: 32
CPU memory: 128GB RAM
GPUs (https://researchcomputing.princeton.edu/systems/della#Hardware-Configuration): 2/4 * A100
Total run time: 40 GPU hours per week
Total disk space: 2TB

A few references or citations:
Learning skillful medium-range global weather forecasting -- R Lam et al., Science 2023
Fourier Neural Operator for Parametric PDEs: Z Li et al., ICLR 2021

Please let me know if you need anything else!

Thanks,
Sam
